title: Douglas Crockford: The JSON Saga
summary: Douglas Crockford tells how JSON was discovered rather than invented, and how its simplicity made it a dominant data interchange format. He also covers surrounding history such as earlier Netscape usage and the 'Good, not Evil' license story.
why: HN commenters cite it as Crockford's first-hand account of JSON's origins and of the no-evil license anecdote.

quote.text: JSON by being so simple actually became really easy to use.
